summary: - **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — Sensitive detectors now keep volume-exit state changes when a step is dropped by the energy filter. Previously, short exit steps below threshold left hits open until the next sensor, which placed hits between sensors (including the spurious z=0 stripes reported in k4geo#538).

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — The calorimeter barrel and endcap face surface plugins accept `symmetry=0` to build cylindrical surfaces instead of polyhedra. ALLEGRO needs this to extrapolate tracks correctly to the ECAL.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance orientation in `prepareTrackerHits`: `du`/`dv` are now rotated from the hit's u/v axes into the ACTS surface frame instead of being assigned directly to loc0/loc1. The old behaviour swapped precise and coarse errors in some endcaps, so good hits failed the CKF chi2 cut and forward tracks were truncated or lost; barrel results are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` option to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`, an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the existing relative error. High-pT seeds can then have their momentum corrected by the CKF without loosening the error on soft seeds, which would otherwise migrate fakes to high pT.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` gains a significance-based matching criterion and now uses it by default. Matching defaults are aligned with CLDConfig's `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder`, so existing merger outputs will change.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` reads the sensor thickness from the sensitive volume instead of the ZPlanarData/ZPetalData extensions. This lets it run on compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO's; CLD output is unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — The GenFit track fitter resets the global TGeoManager navigator before fitting each track. Material lookups at geometry boundaries no longer depend on which track was fitted previously, so fit results no longer depend on processing order.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#116](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/116)** — `GGTFTrackFinder` gains an `EmbeddingCoordinates` property to support models trained with different embedding-space dimensions. Extra model output features are tolerated and ignored rather than crashing inference.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — Fixes `EDMToHepMCConverter`, which set particle energy to the mass and divided vertex time by c instead of multiplying. Fixes the time offset in `FlatSmearVertex` for events shifted along the beam.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now preserves particle ordering and includes vertex time. As a result, ddsim hit collections match between HepMC3 and EDM4hep inputs.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds an option to run conformal tracking with silicon hits in the ALLEGRO o1_v03/o2_v01 digi+reco sequence. It relies on the companion k4Reco and k4geo changes for track saving and calorimeter extrapolation.
- **[key4hep/k4PFHitML#5](https://github.com/key4hep/k4PFHitML/pull/5)** — Aligns HitPF output definitions with Pandora by adding HitPF Clusters and updating the reference-point definition.
